_doc: Lumber loop knowledge (docs/LUMBER_LOOP.md). Every value comes from the user's demonstration capture logs/session_20260929_204225 (loop_mine.py timeline) and is pinned by harness/test_loop_demo.py. Serials are Test Shard, TestWorth, Shelter Island; rooms are wiped daily at 00:00 UTC, so room serials change after a wipe.

vendor.buy_ok_text: The total of thy purchase is 5 gold.  My thanks for the patronage.

harvest.use_tool: dclick the equipped hatchet, then target the tree (location target, static graphic)
harvest.success_text: You chop some logs and put them in your backpack.
harvest.smart_harvest_self_target: untested: the demo targeted trees, one attempt per dclick

area.note: Shelter Island (Young may harvest in town). Candidates are tree statics from map0.uoo; harvest memory learns which ones answer, run dry or can't be reached.

convert.use_tool: dclick the hatchet, target the log stack
convert.ok_text: You shape the logs into boards.
convert.note: logs and boards weigh the same (0.025 st, per-stack ceiling in the status weight); convert once per stack

deed.use: dclick a blank commodity, target the board stack
deed.prompt_text: What resource to you wish to create a commodity for?
deed.too_few_text: Commodity for that item must be of at least 5000.

room.open_menu: say 'room' within range of the innkeeper (worked from 11 tiles), or context menu index 1 'Rent'
room.rent_ok_text: You are now renting a room.

travel_lockout.text_prefix: You have recently traveled and must wait

captcha.decoy_gumps: every harvest attempt also opens a gump with lines ['Captcha','Guide','Type the Value','Click when complete'], a random gump id, no buttons, offscreen text, noclose/nodispose. Never reply to it; detect the real captcha by gump id + text entry + submit button, never by text.
